bullets.text: 過去，推理與行動大多被分開研究。
bullets.quote: have primarily been studied as separate topics.

bullets.text: ReAct 讓 LLM 以交錯的方式，同時產生推理與行動。
bullets.quote: we explore the use of LLMs to generate both reasoning traces and task-specific actions in an interleaved manner

bullets.text: 推理幫助模型規劃與追蹤，行動則讓它取得外部資訊。
bullets.quote: while actions allow it to interface with external sources, such as knowledge bases or environments, to gather additional information.

bullets.text: 這種交錯的做法已成為 agent 的常見模式。
bullets.quote: First proposed by ReAct (Yao et al., 2022), interleaving reasoning and action has become a common pattern for agents.
